ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will stop the credit analyst from selecting the Reason Closed of 'Sent to LoanMe' when a deal is declined. Per email on 2/22 - this validation has been lifted and no longer necessary. See Track It ticket 35442
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Lending_Tree_Id__c)), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Declined'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Internal Decline'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'NF Decline')), ISPICKVAL(Reason_Closed__c, 'Sent to LoanMe'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This transaction was referred to us by Lending Tree. Is it not eligible for LoanMe.
